renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: What is the highest thing, giving Kaula success right away? Just truly knowing it lifts you to the level of the sky-wanderers. Tell me the deepest secret, Lord — the Power in the heart, queen of the clan. Tell me about her, so I come to fullness.
Hear this, blessed Goddess: even the answer has a beyond. This Kaula rite stands in my heart-sky — I tell it, lady of gods: fast results.

First the vowels, all moon-days ending in the drop; inside them, moon and sun are named through time. Realities from earth to person, five by five in sound groups ending in ma. Fourfold holds of wind, fire, water; above, the famed sha-row and five spirit-chiefs.

Rootless, rightly ranged, ksha-capped — this is the unfold, told for all mantras and wisdoms. This is the womb, told in all Tantras always — fourteen-joined, moon-lord-ended, third godhead, Bhairava's own heart.
